controls.name: C_the_edit_is_real
controls.must_fire_because: the probe must actually change the file, or "the verdict did not move" is a statement about nothing (A29)
controls.can_fail_because: the proposed staleness check not seeing the edit either, which would mean nothing changed
controls.null_must_contain: an edit that leaves the bytes identical, which no verdict could be expected to see

controls.name: C_file_is_restored
controls.must_fire_because: the probe edits a COMMITTED file in the live tree and must leave it byte-identical, or this attack has damaged the thing it is measuring
controls.can_fail_because: git reporting the target as modified after this run
controls.null_must_contain: a probe that writes and does not revert, which git would report as modified

controls.name: C_fix_survives_an_identical_rewrite
controls.must_fire_because: the staleness rule must NOT fire on a byte-identical rewrite. The mtime rule this file started with did, and would have reported the live tree stale for a probe that changed nothing
controls.can_fail_because: the target showing stale after the revert, with git reporting it unmodified
controls.null_must_contain: an mtime-based rule, which any rewrite trips

controls.name: C_fix_does_not_flag_everything
controls.must_fire_because: the staleness check must NOT report every claimed spike as stale -- a check that is red on everything carries no information (H14) and would make CLAIMED unreachable
controls.can_fail_because: every claimed spike showing stale code
controls.null_must_contain: a rule that flags any file newer than the record, which prose corrections trip every time a retraction lands

falsifiers.name: F_demo8_already_resolves_currency
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a source edit the proposed check DOES see, which is what makes the non-movement a gap rather than a no-op
falsifiers.refutes: this attack: if demo8 moves its verdict when a claimed spike's source changes after its last green certify, the tool already resolves currency

no_deps_reason: the instrument is `spikes/harness/demo8.py`, imported from the tree under test on purpose -- this attack is about what that file does NOW, and pinning it to HEAD would measure a different question
falsifier: demo8's verdict moving when a claimed spike's source changes, which would mean currency is already resolved
